reentry_change.accepted_mechanism: one SQLite read transaction containing WP206 load_checkpoint plus exact-row re-read and deterministic row-evidence binding before G3/G2

do_not_build_by_default: Do not add data_version to write_checkpoint; it already begins BEGIN IMMEDIATE before row/lineage validation.
Do not add data_version to legacy G4 recovery; it already uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE plus fresh row validation and CAS.
Do not duplicate WP901 G4 snapshot-bound exact-row attestation with a second generic freshness authority.
remaining_candidate_surface: Only a concrete authority-sensitive load-to-use path outside the protected write/recovery/WP901-G4 boundaries may justify EXTERNAL_SQLITE_REVISION_FENCE/v1.
required_next_action: Enumerate exact-current consumers of CanonicalPersistentAgencyStore.load_checkpoint. For any consumer outside an existing transaction/snapshot/generation/attestation fence, reproduce an external same-inode protected mutation between load and authority-sensitive use. Build the revision hint only if that stale continuation is executable and not already caught by downstream gates.
retirement_rule: If no such unprotected load-to-use consumer exists, retire the candidate as useful diagnostics/research evidence but unnecessary product code.
